FitLog imports your Ring Fit Adventure **Exercise Log** into Health Connect from a photo or a Switch screenshot.

**Which APK?** The `arm64` APK works on almost every phone from recent years. The `arm32` APK is only for old 32-bit phones. Requires Android 8.0+ and Health Connect.

- On-device text recognition (ML Kit), no internet, no ads, no analytics.
- Review screen to fix values, dates and start times before saving.
- Saves exercise session, active calories and distance to Health Connect, without duplicates.
- History with weekly and monthly totals, deletion and CSV export.
- English and Spanish.

Not affiliated with Nintendo. Made with AI (Claude Code), directed and tested by its author.

---

FitLog importa tu **Registro de ejercicio** de Ring Fit Adventure a Health Connect desde una foto o una captura de la Switch.

**¿Qué APK descargo?** El APK `arm64` sirve para casi cualquier móvil de los últimos años. El `arm32` es solo para móviles antiguos de 32 bits. Necesita Android 8.0 o superior y Health Connect.
